descriptionInUI: Runtime for the fleet's finite anti-ship missiles. Inert unless the mission generator emits dcsRetribution.navalMagazines (the 'Cross-turn naval magazines' setting is on and a naval group exists). Every anti-ship missile actually fired is counted against that group's campaign stock, a group that runs dry drops back to ReturnFire (winchester, not disarmed), and the expenditure is reported so the turn boundary can debit the persisted magazine -- there is no rearm. The land-attack weapons the cruise-missile plugin meters are excluded, so the two magazines never charge the same shot. Counts real weapon releases and sets ROE only: no spawns, no kills. (The 'Stagger naval weapons release' setting needs no plugin -- it is authored into the mission at generation.)
